objective: Convert verified WorldData FULL one-shot capture into a save-bound, target-specific, provenance-qualified S0 Calendar Sim analysis and a G2 setting-effect readback-ready protocol; pioneer structured evidence-driven Loop observability.

live_capture.source_qualification: partial source-unit completeness, anonymized per-batch GitHub evidence; actual 975MB database remains local

core_loop_observability.scope: pilot observational requirement only; not a Core canonical integration

choices_and_limits: Human has approved Loop observability pilot, not changes to Core master/Canonical state/Workflow/permissions.
Use Calendar Sim only for first-setting-effect protocol; no 3D pooled with the comparison.
FULL and INCREMENTAL cadence remains Human-approved; unchanged final game INCREMENTAL skip is acceptable.
Use existing WorldData v24 single-save SQLite, exact source-unit snapshot and authorized public query/read-only extraction. Do not build second database or capture stack.

No longer assume 238 total league games implies >=10 untreated comparable games for any specific target; calculate per actual player/team, period, game-mode, opponent, injury and setting epochs. No real S1 result can be claimed.
Do not assert the 16 score mismatches have established native cause; 222 exact, 228 within tolerance, 10 beyond tolerance; segregate/flag until evidence supports inclusion.
Do not mix user MC archive with currently reported bound MyLEAGUE0003, which Gemini called save_id nba2k22_test_01. No automatic save rebinding.
Do not treat a historical LIVE_READ somewhere in database as definitive of any current sample; audit actual source units used in each VAE comparison.
Do not change player/coach settings, original game files or save, advance calendar, start resident service, use RDC for ordinary SQL tasks, or merge protected branches.
No unauthorized REA Setter invocation. Read-only review of existing REA Getter/Setter contracts permissible; activation requires future Human authorization.

work_packages.goal: Read fixed G1 source reports, discrepancy categories, old Stage02 M1-M5 pilot metric definitions, existing REA Getter/Setter/Coach contract references; do not re-research all native fields.

Select exactly one first Pilot from original three on data source quality; automatically query per target S0 baseline (>=10 valid comparable Calendar Sim games if available) with settings and stable controls, preserve historical epochs. If not enough, downgrade to S0_PARTIAL with exact missing per-target denominator; do not manufacture matches.

Implement/verify a small allowlisted reusable SQL+manifest extraction profile from existing single-save WorldData, pinned to same source unit per game; flag 16 score anomalies individually (10 outside <=3), unknown Touches, derived values, game modes and frozen-box provenance; no parallel database.

Map one exact canonical setting field to existing REA safe Getter/native Setter research, identify readback availability and minimal experiment schema; do not invoke Setter. Replace arbitrary efficacy rules with measurable hypothesis, confidence, no causal claim.

Execute real local read-only SQL checks on existing captured SQLite if present (no RDC), run targeted regressions; append one structured evidence-producing iteration JSONL record per genuine round, separate initial development and post-delivery amendment rounds, generate summary with actual stop reason/evidence; do not backfill fabricated rounds.

acceptance: Data usage never assumes 238 season games are >=10 per selected team/player in relevant setting-stable window; actual counts and source-unit IDs recorded.
238 game provenance reconciled, scoring anomalies preserved and exclude/flag by metric relevance; 222/228/238 categories not conflated.
Existing library APIs/SQLite schema unchanged except minimum read-only extraction additions; separate save binding preserved.
One pilot only, S0 baseline with actual per-target counts or explicit incomplete; REA readback contract references original evidence (not fake write).
All claims tied to actual test receipts (command, exit code, SHA), code-grade vs live-verified vs missing separated.
Loop observability JSONL and task summary show true evidence-producing iterations, types and stop causality, not counting commands/tests/stage labels as iterations.
Model may end at EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_PENDING if new Calendar Sim needed; an honest pause is allowed, not a fake G2 accepted state.
deliverables: Any minimal extraction code/tests under existing world_data_prototype/

stop_and_review.stop_authority: Core canonical current §11, plus evidence_driven_iteration (candidate branch is proposal only)
stop_and_review.must_review_before: the chosen G2 setting/metric contract becomes a load-bearing authority for real setting writes, or master integration
stop_and_review.prohibited: No actual game modification/sim/calendar, no master change

loop_observability.required: Each real iteration include trigger type/reference, actions, SHA before/after, test receipt exit code, delta and next decision; append-only; final objective/stop evidence and how stop triggered
loop_observability.avoid: Do not equate work_packages P0-P4, command count, test count, commit count or A0-A8 retrospective labels with actual iteration count
loop_observability.post_first_delivery_remediation: count separately under existing Core canonical budget
loop_observability.timestamp_tokens: only with real instrumented evidence else null
